package store

import "github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"

// Bundle hands back an anonymous struct carrying a *Queries field. The result type itself is
// not Queries, but its field is, and a caller only has to reach one level in to get it out.
func Bundle(pool *pgxpool.Pool) struct{ Q *Queries } {
	return struct{ Q *Queries }{Q: &Queries{pool: pool, scopes: Scopes{"personal", "work", "client-globex"}}}
}
